content.comment_body: Hello, we would like to input a setpoint from the operator display into the [product_name] PLC. How can this be accomplished?
You can utilize the function buttons on the operator display in combination with a counter. The value from the counter can then be used as a reference in other blocks.
Thank you. [user_name], one more question: how do I set constants for comparison in [product_name]? Please advise. Thanks again.
Could you clarify your goal? I'm not sure what you mean.

Hello [user_name], One solution is to use the analog comparator block. Other mathematical comparisons can be tested with a threshold trigger block. Check the German section of this forum at [url] (my response from 03.08.2010); I think it provides relevant information. Best regards, [user_name]
Alternatively, you can use the analog threshold trigger. Make sure that both the on and off values are the same, and set your desired threshold (constant) in both fields.
